website.title: Workshop catalogue website
website.phase1: Build a polished single-page website for a small workshop studio. Render the six records in workshops.json as cards (data-workshop-id), a hero, navigation and a booking form. Expose pure exports in catalogue.js: filterWorkshops(items, filters) and validateBooking(values). filters = {query, category, maxPrice, sort}; query is trimmed, case-insensitive and matches title or city; category 'all' disables category filtering; maxPrice null/empty means no cap, otherwise inclusive; sort is 'title', 'price-asc' or 'price-desc', with id ascending as the tie breaker. Never mutate input. UI controls: #query, #category, #max-price, #sort; each change updates visible cards and #result-count, and no results shows #empty-state. validateBooking({name,email,workshopId}, optionalItems) returns {valid,errors}; errors has keys only for invalid fields, blank/whitespace name and invalid email are rejected, workshopId must belong to the six available records. The UI form has #booking-name, #booking-email, #booking-workshop, #booking-submit and #booking-status; a valid local submission acknowledges booking, invalid input shows field errors and does not acknowledge success. No backend. Include visible labels, focus styles and no horizontal overflow at mobile width. Keep implementation easy to extend.
website.phase2: Continue the existing workshop website in a new development session. Preserve all original behavior. Add a shortlist: every card has a button data-shortlist-id equal to its workshop id. Export toggleShortlist(ids,id,items) returning a new deduplicated array, removing selected ids on toggle and rejecting unknown ids; export loadShortlist(raw,items) accepting stored JSON text, returning a deduplicated array of known ids and [] for malformed/non-array storage. Persist the shortlist under localStorage key 'workshop-shortlist'; show count in #shortlist-count; survive reload. Add shareable filters: export encodeFilters(filters) returning a query string and decodeFilters(query) returning {query,category,maxPrice,sort} with safe defaults ('','all',null,'title') for invalid values. Recognize category pottery/wood/photo, sort title/price-asc/price-desc, and finite nonnegative maxPrice. Initialize controls from URL and update URL with history.replaceState when controls change. Reset button #reset-filters must restore defaults and remove filter query parameters while preserving shortlist. Document any incomplete behavior and finish the session.

game.title: Memory pairs browser game
game.phase1: Build a playable browser memory-pairs game with four pairs, keyboard-accessible tile buttons (data-card-id), #moves, #game-status and #restart. A shuffled deck is used for play. Export from game.js createGame(deck), flip(state,id), resolveMismatch(state), restart(state,deck). deck is an array of {id,symbol}, exactly eight unique ids and two of each symbol; createGame returns mutable state {cards,selected,moves,matched,locked,status}, cards copy the deck with faceUp=false and matched=false; selected is ids, moves counts completed two-card attempts, matched counts pairs, locked is boolean, status is 'playing' or 'won'. flip returns boolean accepted and mutates state: reject unknown/already revealed/matched ids, block flips while a mismatch is locked, first flip selects one card, second increments moves; matching pairs remain face up, increment matched and clear selected immediately; mismatches remain visible and locked until resolveMismatch turns only those two down and clears selection. All four pairs means status='won'. restart resets every gameplay field using the supplied deck without altering the caller's deck. UI automatically resolves a mismatch after 500-900ms and announces win/moves. Never create multiple active mismatch timers after restart. Avoid input mutation, UI script errors, horizontal overflow at 390px. Include a concise rules section and focus styles.
game.phase2: Continue this game in a fresh session and preserve existing behavior. Add #pause toggling pause/resume, export pause(state), resume(state); state.paused defaults false. Paused flips are rejected without changing cards/moves/selection. Pausing while a mismatch is visible must not turn it down until play resumes; resolveMismatch must also no-op when paused. Restart clears paused and locked and cancels obsolete UI timers. Add a best completed score (fewest moves), export updateBest(current,moves,status): only positive integer moves for status='won' can update; null/invalid current behaves as no previous score; incomplete/invalid results preserve a valid existing best or null; ties preserve score. UI #best-score persists under localStorage 'memory-best', handles malformed storage safely and updates only upon win. Display a clear paused status, let restart work while paused, and finish with verified handover.

app.title: Task board web application prototype
app.phase1: Build a usable three-column task board (todo/doing/done) with local persistence and accessible forms. Export from board.js createBoard(), addTask(board,input), editTask(board,id,patch), moveTask(board,id,status), deleteTask(board,id), listTasks(board,filters), serialize(board), restore(raw). Mutable board = {tasks:[],nextId:1}; tasks = {id:string,title:string,status:'todo'|'doing'|'done',priority:'low'|'medium'|'high'}. addTask trims title, rejects blank title or invalid priority/status with false and no mutation; defaults todo/medium; successful return is task with unique stable id. editTask returns boolean and atomically validates a nonblank trimmed title and valid priority/status in provided fields, preserving id. moveTask rejects unknown id or invalid status; deleteTask rejects unknown id. listTasks never mutates board and filters by trimmed case-insensitive title query, optional status/priority ('all' disables), returning insertion order. serialize returns JSON text; restore validates the complete data shape, unique ids, nonblank titles and enum values, recovers nextId so future ids cannot collide, and returns an empty board for malformed storage. UI: #task-title, #task-priority, #add-task, #task-query, #priority-filter; each card data-task-id contains title, a select data-move-id and a delete button data-delete-id. Columns have data-column equal to status. #task-count reflects filtered count. Persist under localStorage 'task-board', reload correctly, render unsafe title input literally and handle corrupt storage without crashing. Responsive at 390px, meaningful labels/focus styles, no remote calls.
app.phase2: Resume this prototype in a fresh development session. Keep original behaviors. Add one-level undo for the latest successful add/edit/move/delete: export undo(board) returns boolean, restoring tasks and nextId exactly; after one undo another returns false; failed operations must not erase an available undo. Restored imported boards start without undo history; serialize excludes undo internals. Add atomic JSON import: export importBoard(board,raw) returns boolean; only fully valid boards replace current state and clear undo, invalid input (including duplicate ids or invalid fields) returns false with current board and undo unchanged. Allow an empty valid board. UI #undo button and #import-json textarea with #import-button and #import-status must expose these actions, update/persist immediately, and display import failures without dropping existing tasks. Add #export-button that places serialize output into #export-json (textarea). Test the change and finish the session with a handover.
